subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: What group admission contract should OpenClaw support for unconfigured Telegram and WhatsApp groups before any channel-specific implementation lands?
rationale: The request changes authorization, notification routing, persistent approval state, and optional untrusted-content processing, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Define shared opt-in group pairing
options.body: Add a cross-channel group admission contract with pending state, owner notification, authorized approve/reject operations, docs, tests, and live Telegram/WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Split observation from approval
options.body: Keep group approval as its own design item and direct read-only/listen-only observation to the existing plugin hook or external plugin path unless maintainers explicitly want it in core.

options.title: Keep allowlist-only group admission
options.body: Reject group pairing for now and document allowlist, disabled, unknown-group warn/leave, and plugin listen-only alternatives as the supported paths.

recommendation.title: Define shared opt-in group pairing
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel group admission contract with pending state, owner notification, authorized approve/reject operations, docs, tests, and live Telegram/WhatsApp proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history across the central config/security/channel paths and is the visible prior reviewer for this issue.
